mapper.insert: INSERT INTO parameter_template ( name, device_model, version, status, reference_shaft, envelope_band_hint, content, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{name}, #{deviceModel}, #{version}, #{status}, #{referenceShaft}, #{envelopeBandHint}, CAST(#{content} AS jsonb), #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, device_model, version, status, reference_shaft, envelope_band_hint, content::text AS content, created_at, updated_at FROM parameter_template WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid)
SELECT id, name, device_model, version, status, reference_shaft, envelope_band_hint, content::text AS content, created_at, updated_at FROM parameter_template ORDER BY updated_at DESC
mapper.update:
UPDATE parameter_template
name = #{name}, device_model = #{deviceModel}, version = #{version}, status = #{status}, reference_shaft = #{referenceShaft}, envelope_band_hint = #{envelopeBandHint}, content = CAST(#{content} AS jsonb), updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid)
